walkingAssumptions.source: Plan 1 repaired path graph and walking baseline only
walkingAssumptions.graphOnlyLimitation: Walking estimates use repaired Plan 1 graph-derived route proof where available and do not infer unmodeled paths.

taskDurationAssumptions.jitterInterpretation: Synthetic deterministic plus-or-minus bound per generated task.

taskFrequencyAssumptions.unit: synthetic tasks per occupied room per hour

passed.label: Passed
passed.meaning: Required checks passed with no notices.

info.label: Info
info.meaning: Informational notice only; does not imply warning or block progress.

warning.label: Warning
warning.meaning: Operational modeling concern that should be reviewed but does not block deterministic fixture generation.

blocking.label: Blocking
blocking.meaning: Contract or scope violation that blocks the current stage.

limitations: Assumptions are synthetic operational modeling inputs.
Walking assumptions are limited to repaired Plan 1 graph and baseline proof.
Queue, handoff, interruption, and overload thresholds are dry-run foundation assumptions only.
nonClaims: Not based on real patient, staff, EHR, or hospital data.
